- **White cottony/mycelial growth** on the lower stem near the soil line
- Stem rot at the crown/soil interface
- Wilted, dead leaves around the plant
- Damage concentrated at soil line

The reference image matches very well: white cottony mycelium on the lower stem at the soil line, crown rot, same presentation as the test image.
